description: Register (or update) an identity-assertion issuer for this tenant's enterprise-managed auth: identity assertions with iss equal to issuer, from client_id, verified against jwks_url, mint a token for the employee they name -- no consent screen. Up to 4 trusted issuers per tenant; a 5th is refused quota_trusted_issuers; an issuer already trusted by another tenant is refused issuer_already_registered.

audience.description: Expected assertion `aud`, when the provider signs one other than this host's own issuer URL.

client_id.description: The pre-registered enterprise client id allowed to use this issuer's grant.

issuer.description: The identity assertion's `iss` claim value to match.

jwks_url.description: URL this host fetches the issuer's JWKS from.

tenant_key.description: The key `signup` returned. Required only when this connection carries no Authorization: Bearer header -- when both are present, the header wins.

name: host.oauth.trusted_issuer_set
